basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old transmasculine individual living in the vibrant city of Minneapolis, Minnesota. I work as a graphic designer during the day, but my true passion lies in creating art that speaks to the soul. My interests include crocheting, collecting plush toys, and spending weekends exploring the great outdoors with my trusty sketchbook in hand. I've been with my partner for over five years, and we share a small apartment filled with plants and art. I'm typically online in the evenings after work and occasionally during lunch breaks. I dislike rigid gender norms and enjoy expressing myself through fashion and art.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Fine Arts from the University of Minnesota, where I developed a keen interest in digital design and artistic expression. I've also self-taught myself various crafts, such as crocheting, through online tutorials and community workshops. My knowledge of gender identity and LGBTQ+ issues comes from personal experience and engagement with supportive online communities.
